purpose: Canonical Listener 1.0.2 preproduction physical acceptance scenarios. Human, bench, regression, and release audit gates must use this file as the scenario source of truth.

scenarios.product_contract: Preproduction must use the latest MSI-updated user installation: Program Files listener-type.exe, desktop Listener Type.lnk, and tray startup must all resolve to the installed MSI payload, not a repo build output. The Type process evidence must include ExecutablePath, FileVersion, ProductVersion, and Sha256.

Cold boot PWR must show the same capped warm amber color and brightness as the shutdown-confirm PWR cue without an all-black first latch; startup time is measured from boot PWR lighting to stable BLE-visible readiness, so boot amber must remain until BLE is truly visibly ready and no startup-complete/PWR-normal cue may be shown early to fake a faster boot. During this focused PWR/EC11 confirmation, a straight EC11 push must not be decoded as a rotation, and the existing EC11 pending-shutdown fill effect must not intermittently black out and then restore during the long press.

scenarios.bench_title: Type LED brightness and low-power exact sync
scenarios.product_contract: Type defaults status/key LED brightness to 50/80, writes each LED zone brightness as firmware caps, allows brightness number fields to be cleared and retyped without a leading-zero value such as 050, and preserves every low-power minute value exactly without hidden dimming or readback rounding.
Writing the current BLE name again must be a normal settings write only: no DEVICE:SET ble_name, no BLE-name apply, no Windows cache refresh, no PairAsync, and no pairing prompt.

scenarios.bench_title: Random BLE name exact cache refresh
scenarios.product_contract: Writing a different valid BLE name must update firmware, clear this PC's stale pairing/cache through the same Type-controlled recovery path, show the same BLE blue double-flash/reconnect recovery cue as Type-controlled double-click repair, reconnect without opening this PC's Windows Bluetooth Settings/user pairing prompt, leave Windows/Type displaying the exact new fully random ASCII name with no listener/LT/type family prefix, and use silent rename recovery so other computers do not receive a Swift Pair prompt during rename. Explicit cross-computer re-pair remains the double-click/native Windows pairing flow. Same-name writes remain no-repair/no-prompt.

Restoring the default BLE name listener is a different-name rename when the current name is not listener, so it must run the same Type-controlled cache refresh/reconnect path, show the same BLE blue double-flash/reconnect recovery cue, avoid opening this PC's Windows Bluetooth Settings/user pairing prompt, suppress Swift Pair prompts on other computers during rename, then prove exact display-name confirmation.

scenarios.bench_title: Manual Windows delete must not autopair with Type

scenarios.product_contract: With Listener Type fully exited and no listener-type.exe process, Windows native Add device > Bluetooth must pair listener without Type PairAsync, leave BTHLE listener OK, configure/start HID service 00001812, and expose a keyboard.inf/kbdhid Col01 keyboard path instead of looping between connected and disconnected.

After no-Type native pairing, reopening the latest installed MSI Listener Type must take over the existing paired listener without PairAsync, Windows pairing prompt, forced repair, or device deletion. The process must be C:\Program Files\Listener Type\listener-type.exe, Windows Bluetooth must keep BTHLE listener OK, Type must start background BLE capture and reach background listener notify ready within 3 seconds on the persisted startup path, then device-key recording/control events must be delivered without requiring re-pair.

EC11 single click must remain a single-click action and must not open pairing recovery. A fast EC11 double click must cancel the first pending single click, avoid starting dictation, and enter the BLE recovery cue before the full Type automatic recovery scenario is judged.

scenarios.bench_title: EC11 double-click repair with Type automatic recovery
scenarios.product_contract: With Type present, double-click repair first clears this PC's stale Windows pairing cache, then waits for the fresh Listener recovery advertisement before running the bounded Type PairAsync recovery path automatically. If another computer completes Windows popup pairing first, this Type instance must stop waiting instead of looping or stealing the bond back.

scenarios.bench_title: Computer switch flow with and without Type
scenarios.product_contract: Without Type, the user must manually remove stale Windows pairing before native pairing. With Type on the target PC, Type may clear local stale pairing first, then wait for the fresh Listener recovery advertisement and run bounded automatic PairAsync recovery; if another host pairs first, the old Type instance must stop instead of looping or stealing the bond back.

When any device custom key is configured as Dictation, the first valid press after connected/disconnected low-power idle wake must not be swallowed: firmware records wake activity, continues the ordinary debounce path instead of synthesizing a false click, sends the F13-F24 fallback HID event for the configured key/gesture, Type maps that device key action to Dictation, and the capsule/audio/LED recording path begins normally.

Denzic root may contain only ListenerType_1.0.2_x64_en-US.msi and ListenerFirmware_1.0.2_ota.zip. The root MSI hash must match the latest Type MSI source artifact, the root firmware OTA zip hash must match the latest stable firmware OTA source artifact, and no Type portable zip or older package may remain.
